Official 2026 maximum C$54.95 a night for any campsite; booked online. Season mid-May to late September. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: official Bonjour Québec 2026 maximum, operator site live (C$54.95, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); official 2026 maximum C$54.95 for any campsite; Google 4.4 over 188 with phone; C$54.95 ~ US$40
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 49.48545,-67.23279: loops on a terrace east of Route 138 above a tidal bay of the St. Lawrence at Îlets-Caribou; the east rows (the operator's panoramic sites) overlook the bay's flats across a shrubby bank ~20-40 m wide (bench above, climb-down); bayview

name: Camping Sainte-Madeleine
note: 282-site campground beside Autoroute 20 exit 120 at Sainte-Madeleine (traffic noise on the east side), about 200 sites seasonal and 77 sold online; the Rivière Huron runs through the park; pool, splash pad, disc golf. 2026: one night C$55 water+electric, C$59 3-service + tax (10% off before 4 June and after 14 September); a July 2027 weeknight sells online at C$59. Season about May to September. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$59, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); 77 sites sold online of 282 (~27%); Google 4.0 over 165 with phone; C$59 ~ US$42
wf: operator 2024 per-site plan + satellite (Esri z17/z18) at 45.6037,-73.1036: the narrow Rivière Huron runs through the park under full canopy (satellite cannot resolve it), and the per-site plan draws rows 101-113 and the 2-service 30A rows 60-69 backing directly onto it; creek-sized stream; creekside

name: Camping 2 Rivières
note: 200+-site campground at the confluence of two rivers at Saint-Gédéon-de-Beauce (Route 204), part seasonal; heated pool, canteen, dek hockey, BMX and ninja courses, river fishing; new owners since 2021. 2026: 2-service C$56-58, 3-service 30A C$62 a night + tax (2 adults + 2 children). Serviced sites are booked by contacting the office; only rustic field sites sell online. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$56, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); May 2020 closed-season frame: stored trailers on ~2/3 of 200+ pads, western rows empty; Google 4.3 over 87 with phone; C$56 ~ US$40
wf: satellite (Esri z18) at 45.7959,-70.6346: the park's east rows line a lane ~10-25 m from the ~40-60 m wide rocky river north-west of the Route 204 bridge, behind a partial riparian treeline (view through gaps, not open access); the western rows (mostly empty in a May 2020 pre-opening frame, likely the traveller section) are away from the water; riverview

name: Camping de la Mine de Cuivre
note: About 140-site campground at Eastman (Eastern Townships) around a pond, with 47 sites sold online and the rest seasonal; heated pool, splash pad, outdoor cinema. 2026: 2-service 30A C$58, 3-service C$64 a night in high season, tax extra (2 adults + 2 children); one-night stays at the nightly rate. Several 2-service sites cap at 24-28 ft. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$58, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); 47 sites sold online of ~140 (~33%); Google 4.3 over 249 with phone; C$58 ~ US$42

name: Camping au Soleil St-Côme
note: Camping au Soleil park at Saint-Côme (Lanaudière), 142 sites and mostly seasonal: the traveller section is about 17 sites (2- and 3-service, 30A and 50A pull-throughs) sold online one night at a time; pool, restaurant, river access. 2026 indicative rates 2-service C$65, 3-service C$65-75 + tax; a mid-October 2026 weeknight sold at C$60 (2-service) + C$5 booking fee. Season 1 May-31 Oct. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$65, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); ~17 traveller sites of 142 (~12%) free on a mid-October weeknight; Google 4.4 over 177 with phone; C$65 ~ US$47
wf: operator 2026 plan + satellite (Esri z18) at 46.2846,-73.7952: the loops run NE from Rang Versailles under pines; the Rivière L'Assomption lies ~40-60 m beyond the north-east rows through forest, reached by the plan's 'accès à la rivière' path (access, not frontage); default down; not waterfront

name: Domaine Parc Estrie (Parkbridge)
note: Parkbridge RV resort at Magog: about 490 RV sites, roughly 135 of them Voyageur (traveller) sites and the rest seasonal/annual; pool, splash pad, clay tennis, pickleball, restaurant, Route Verte bike path alongside. Online engine, Tuesday 13 Jul 2027: partial service (water/electric) 30A C$41, full service C$55, 50A C$70 a weeknight before tax (C$57-76 Fri-Sat). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator booking engine quote (Parkbridge RMS) (C$41, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); ~135 Voyageur cells of ~490 on the 2026 resort map (~28%); Google 4.5 over 394 with phone; C$41 ~ US$30
wf: Parkbridge resort map + satellite (Esri z17) at 45.2924,-72.1016: a dense grid of rows on the south side of Magog; only small ornamental ponds near the entrance and treatment basins to the south, no pads on any water; Lac Memphrémagog is in town, not at the park; not waterfront

name: Camping Union Parc de la Chaudière
note: Camping Union network campground on the east bank of the Chaudière River at Scott (Beauce), 20 min from Quebec City; 178 sites, mostly seasonal, with a separate traveller section and separately priced riverside sites; pool, water slide. 2026: 2-service 30A C$55.50, 3-service C$63.50, riverside C$74 a night + tax. Online reservations need 2 nights; the same-day Nuitée Express (after 16:00, out by 09:00, 20% off) and walk-ins sell single nights. Season 15 May-12 Oct 2026. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$55.5, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); May 2020 closed-season frame: separate block of ~35-45 empty pads of 178; Google 4.4 over 273 with phone; C$55.5 ~ US$40

name: Camping de l'Estrie
note: About 200-site campground at Shefford between Granby and Bromont, roughly 47 traveller sites (2- and 3-service, some 50A) and the rest seasonal; lakeside sites on a small pond, pool, splash pad, pump track, RV mechanics. 2027 before tax: 2-service C$57, 3-service C$65 (lakeside/50A C$72) in high season, and a July 2027 weeknight sells online at those prices; 3 nights on long weekends. Traveller season 30 Apr-11 Oct 2027. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$57, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); ~47 traveller sites of ~200 on the 2026 map (~24%); Google 4.4 over 347 with phone; C$57 ~ US$41

name: Camping des Chutes Hunter
note: 366-site campground at Frelighsburg, 5 km from the Vermont border, with at least 52 serviced traveller sites sold online one night at a time; pool, beach, restaurant, pickleball. 2026 traveller rates: 2-service C$46, 3-service 30A C$52, 50A C$56 a night (7th night free); official 2026 maximum C$58.95. Season 2 May-13 Oct 2026. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$46, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); 52 serviced traveller sites free for a July 2027 night of 366 (>=14%); Google 4.0 over 430 with phone; C$46 ~ US$33

name: Camping La Gervaisie
note: About 118-site campground at Saint-Tite, mostly traveller (about 80 traveller sites, 24 seasonal, rental trailers), every site 3-service; heated pool, beach and boat rentals on Lac Trottier across the lane. 2026 traveller rate C$65.25 a night + tax. Reservations by phone only (from 1 April, 50% non-refundable deposit, balance by debit or cash); 2 nights on weekends, 3 on holidays and during the Festival Western in September. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$65.25, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); ~80 traveller sites of ~118 on the 2025 plan; Google 4.2 over 127 with phone; C$65.25 ~ US$47
